title: Hotwire, Turbo & Stimulus
intro: Hotwire — Turbo + Stimulus — is the default frontend stack for Rails 7 and 8, and interviewers at Rails companies now expect you to understand it. Turbo Drive replaces full-page loads with fetch requests; Turbo Frames replace partial sections of the page; Turbo Streams push real-time DOM updates over WebSocket or SSE from the server. Stimulus adds small controllers that add behaviour to server-rendered HTML without the overhead of a SPA framework. This page covers all three layers: how they compose, the difference between Turbo Frames (synchronous request) and Turbo Streams (asynchronous push), when to use each, and the critical comparison interviewers always ask — when is Hotwire enough vs when should you reach for React or Vue.
